description: We are a team of passionate engineering students tackling The Earth Information Jukebox challenge for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our goal is to innovate by transforming complex Earth science datasets into interactive, accessible, and meaningful insights through modeling and technology
summary: Developed using audiovisual methods, this project illustrates global temperature changes across key milestones from the early 1880s through 2025. To achieve this, we combined modern programming tools with official datasets sourced directly from NASA. Our primary goal is to raise public awareness about the ongoing shifts in Earth's climate. Ultimately, this project offers an interactive experience that allows users to clearly visualize how global temperatures are rising dramatically year after year.
details:
Our project presents climate change through an immersive audiovisual experience designed to raise public awareness about this critical issue, formally known as 'global warming' or informally as the 'rise in average surface temperature.' Because the impact of global warming is directly reflected in rising mortality rates over time, our project clearly illustrates this connection alongside temperature increases.

Built using HTML, JSON, Python 3.15, Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, and Visual Studio Code, this project stands out by offering an engaging way for people to learn about the real problems facing our planet. As a team, we developed this solution by carefully analyzing data provided by NASA and examining the broader context of this urgent global challenge.
